name: Sinofibers Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sinofibers Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of carbon fibers and fabrics in China and internationally. The company offers polyacrylonitrile-based carbon fibers, woven carbon fiber fabrics, and structural and functional materials. Its products are used in the aerospace, weaponry, aviation, and electronics industries. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Changzhou, China.
